extDescription.message: Blocks distracting sites during your schedule. Before you unlock early, talk to a real person.

addSiteTitle.message: What do you want to protect yourself from?

addSiteSub.message: Add the site you want to block. You can add more than one.

confidentialNote.message: This is your space, only yours. The sites you add here are confidential.

motivationalQuestion1.message: What exactly do you want to see right now?

motivationalQuestion2.message: What would happen if you waited 10 more minutes before deciding?

motivationalQuestion3.message: What were you planning to do during this time before the idea of going in showed up?

offerChatTitle.message: Do you want to talk to someone before continuing?

offerChatSub.message: A real person — not a bot — can be with you for 5 minutes before you decide, at no cost.

yesChatBtn.message: Yes, I want to talk for 5 min

queuedSub.message: We already let your support person know. Your chat time hasn't started counting yet — that only starts once the conversation begins.

farewellBanner.message: Your support person is about to say goodbye — the chat closes in one minute.

donationTitle.message: Help us keep this space running

donationSub.message: Your donation helps pay for the time of the people who support you. It's 100% optional.

finalConfirmTitle.message: Do you still want to unlock $DOMAIN$?

finalConfirmSub.message: This is your decision, take a second before answering.

stayedBlockedSub.message: You can close this tab whenever you want.

feeSelectionTitle.message: Choose how much time you need

recurrenceFeeNote.message: The fee is doubled due to repeat use this week.

waitingPaymentSub.message: It opened in another tab. As soon as the payment is confirmed, this site unlocks on its own.

unlockedSub.message: You can close this tab and go back in.

reincidenceTitle.message: You already made this decision today

reincidenceSub.message: You unlocked $DOMAIN$ earlier. No need to decide again — tomorrow is a new day and you can start fresh.
